about.title: Hi, I'm Bea.
about.p1: I'm a passionate and dedicated acrobatic gymnastics coach with a lifelong connection to the sport. A former elite gymnast and now a coach at Acro Clube da Maia, I combine first-hand competitive experience with professional coaching skills to support athletes' technical development, discipline and motivation.
about.p2: Throughout my journey I have developed strong leadership and communication skills and a deep commitment to excellence. I aim to inspire athletes to grow not only in performance, but also in confidence, resilience and love for the sport.

testimonials.title: What coaches say.
testimonials.text: Top coaches who have followed Bea's journey.

items.name: Lourenço França
items.role: Head Acrobatic Gymnastics Coach · Acro Clube da Maia and Portugal National Team
items.quote: Beatriz is a young coach who has carried into her new role many of the qualities she developed as a gymnast.
items.excerpt: She is one of those athletes who only stops when the job is done (and this is a trait that may seem simple, but is truly distinctive). Determined and persistent, she faced very difficult moments throughout her gymnastics career.
full: Beatriz is a young coach who has carried into her new role many of the qualities she developed as a gymnast. She is one of those athletes who only stops when the job is done (and this is a trait that may seem simple, but is truly distinctive).

Determined and persistent, she faced very difficult moments throughout her gymnastics career - challenges that would have led many others to quit. For her, however, they became fuel to strive for more. And indeed, she achieved it: World Champion and three-time Junior European Champion, Senior World silver medalist and Senior European silver medalist, as well as a medalist at two World Games over more than a decade of high-level competition. These are accomplishments within reach of very few in Acrobatic Gymnastics.

What is even more impressive is that these titles were achieved in different disciplines - Women's Pairs and Women's Groups - which is even rarer and more demanding. Throughout her career, she dealt with injuries, both her own and those of her partners (each presenting its own challenges). Yet, in the most difficult moments, she was the driving force that pushed the group forward.

These are the attributes she has carried into her new career as a coach, and which she continues to develop. Alongside her constant desire for learning, they are among the most important qualities any coach can aspire to have.

items.name: João Ferreira
items.role: Head Acrobatic Gymnastics Coach in Switzerland · AGG ACRO
items.quote: A resilient, methodical athlete who is demanding of herself.
items.excerpt: She has always shown an understanding that goals are not always immediate, respecting the process required to achieve them. At the beginning of her career as a coach, she combines her experience as an athlete with a solid background in Physical Education.
full: A resilient, methodical athlete who is demanding of herself. She has always shown an understanding that goals are not always immediate, respecting the process required to achieve them. At the beginning of her career as a coach, she combines her experience as an athlete with a solid background in Physical Education, which is reflected in a conscious, structured and responsible approach, with a strong concern for building consistent technical and human foundations in the gymnasts she works with.

items.name: Joana Patrocínio
items.role: Head Acrobatic Gymnastics Coach in Switzerland · RLZO Akrobatik Turnen
items.quote: Seeing Beatriz become a coach makes complete sense.
items.excerpt: Her dedication to Acrobatic Gymnastics is immense and has been there for as long as anyone can remember. Now, it is only natural that she can pass on all her knowledge and values to the younger ones.
full: Seeing Beatriz become a coach makes complete sense. Her dedication to Acrobatic Gymnastics is immense and has been there for as long as anyone can remember. Now, it is only natural that she can pass on all her knowledge and values to the younger ones - and to everyone who wants to learn from her.

items.name: Yves Vander Donckt
items.role: High-Performance Acrobatic Coach in Germany · Sportakrobatik Rechberghausen
items.quote: Beatriz maintains very high personal standards and approaches training with discipline and determination.
items.excerpt: Beatriz's ambition and expectations of herself are reflected in her training environment. She naturally brings intensity and focus, which are important qualities in high-performance settings.
full: Beatriz maintains very high personal standards and approaches training with discipline and determination.

Beatriz's ambition and expectations of herself are reflected in her training environment. She naturally brings intensity and focus, which are important qualities in high-performance settings, although they can sometimes present challenges in more diverse team dynamics. Nevertheless, her dedication to excellence is undeniable.

Her competitive background includes participation in European Championships, World Championships, World Cups, and notably, she is a two-time World Games participant, an achievement that reflects a very high level of international recognition, as well as extensive stage experience in numerous shows. This breadth of experience is a significant asset that she brings to any environment.

Beatriz has developed her own approach through years of experience. Looking ahead, one of her key areas for growth will be continuing to expand her perspective and adapting her methods to suit different athletes, while maintaining the high standards she values. Importantly, she shows a clear willingness to learn, she is often the first to engage with new ideas, skills, or training methods.
